completion:
Write down the date and time.
3. Record the model, make, and serial number of the appliance.
4. Note the location where the check was performed.
5. Identify the tester or technician's information.
6. Document the reason for the check (e.g., routine maintenance, malfunction report).
7. State the type(s) of safety checks performed (e.g., visual inspection, earth bond test, insulation resistance test).
8. Numerically record all measured values and set thresholds for pass/fail.
9. State clearly the results of each test (pass, fail, or needs repair).
10. Include detailed observations and specific issues found during the tests.
11. Photograph any damage or defects, if possible, and reference them in the document.
12. For failures, describe the nature of the failure and any immediate risks (e.g., electric shock, fire hazard).
